item.title: Christopher Judge Once Shared a Great Idea For a Teal’c STARGATE SG-1 Spinoff Series
item.description: One of the biggest reasons Stargate SG-1 endured for ten seasons wasn’t just the wormholes and alien tech. It was the team at the center of it all. item.title: Before TOY STORY, Jim Henson Made a Toy Story Christmas Spiecal That Brought Toys To Life
item.description: Years before Toy Story convinced audiences that toys had secret lives, Jim Henson was already telling that story in his own weird, heartfelt way. Back in 1986, Henson produced a Christmas television special called The Christmas Toy, and it leaned hard into the idea that toys absolutely spring to life the moment humans leave the room.
